title: Payment replay and ordering

observations.name: real hosted checkout replay
observations.detail: pass; expected: 201 with hosted URL; same command replays; actual: first=201; replay=201; same_url=true; command: POST /member/checkout-sessions twice with same Idempotency-Key

observations.name: forged success return
observations.detail: pass; expected: no subscription created; actual: return_HTTP=404; before=0; after=0; command: GET forged billing return; SELECT member subscriptions

observations.name: invalid signature
observations.detail: pass; expected: 401, no inbox row; actual: HTTP 401 WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID; inbox_rows=0; command: POST exact webhook bytes with invalid Stripe-Signature

observations.name: ten deliveries
observations.detail: pass; expected: one durable inbox key; actual: accepted=10/10; inbox_rows=1; command: POST same paid event ten times; SELECT source/external_event_id uniqueness

observations.name: all six delivery orders
observations.detail: pass; expected: 18 authenticated inbox deliveries; actual: accepted=18/18; command: POST created/paid/failed in every permutation

observations.name: authoritative provider precondition
observations.detail: pass; expected: record snapshot availability; actual: HTTP 404 ; command: GET controlled payment provider /v1/subscriptions/{id}

observations.name: pending entitlement revision
observations.detail: pass; expected: unreconciled deliveries do not extend interval; actual: before=1; after=1; command: SELECT entitlements.revision before/after webhook sequence

observations.name: unreconciled event cannot grant
observations.detail: pass; expected: pending member has no live entitlement; actual: pending_payment; command: GET /member/me; SELECT effective entitlement

observations.name: blocked
observations.detail: The running control origin returns 404 for /billing/return; no rendered Portal return page is served. No-rights side effect is observed, but the frontend-return journey is unavailable.

observations.name: blocked
observations.detail: Controlled payment provider returns 404 for the authoritative subscription snapshot and empty invoice/refund lists. Inbox replay/order is exercised; no paid subscription can reconcile, so one paid interval, revision stability after successful reconciliation, refunds and gateway authorization remain blocked. Add mutable snapshots to fvpn-e2e-payment, not fake production entitlements.
